_comment: SIM1-DISPATCH: the disposition of every roster-writing function the direct-call sim closure MISSES. Consumed by tools/check_dispatch_closure.py. The sim migration closure is a forward DIRECT-CALL walk from llm_strat_sim_step; the per-tick behaviour of units/buildings is dispatched through fn-ptr tables (llm_strat_register_state_handlers) and so is invisible to it (docs/libmh-pivot.md, docs/dead-ends.md A). This file records, for each missed roster writer, WHICH subsystem owns it, so 'the closure omits a sim-state writer with no owner' becomes a check that can go red. handler_seeds + owned_roots are derived (reachability); overrides are the authored residue the reachability could not place. Regenerate the measurement with tools/check_dispatch_closure.py.
handler_seeds_comment: The unit + building state-machine handlers installed by llm_strat_register_state_handlers (0x0045f26a). These are the fn-ptr-dispatch roots the closure cannot reach; the DISPATCH disposition = a seed OR anything a seed reaches by direct call. The FOLD (gen_migration) must pull these + their reach into the sim closure as real rows with batches. SECOND SEED SET (SIM1-BLDGCB, 2026-08-23): check_dispatch_closure.py ALSO seeds from the 30 per-building-TYPE callbacks in tools/data/sim_bldg_type_callback_table.json (llm_strat_register_bldg_type_callbacks @0x0045f76a, boot stage 5 -> BLDG_DONE_FUNCS / BLDG_TICK2_FUNCS). That set is EXTRACTED from the disassembly rather than listed here, so it cannot drift out of step with the binary the way an authored list can; it is not folded into this array for the same reason.
owned_roots_comment: A missed roster writer reachable (direct-call) from one of these roots is owned by that subsystem, not the sim tick. Attribution priority: DISPATCH > tactical(prefix) > orders > save > net > boot.
overrides_comment: The residue reachability could not place. category is the believed owner; review:true means it is a lead to confirm during the fold, not an established fact. 'sim_indirect' = believed a sim behaviour reached from a handler via a SECOND indirect edge the seed-walk did not capture (confirm the edge, then it folds into the sim closure). 'boot' = initial-state / scenario / new-game setup (LIB-BOOT territory, not the per-tick sim). 'save' = load/resync path (RI-SAVE). 'scripted' = a scripted-event driver (AI-CREATE). ('bldg_type_callbacks' WAS a category here for the SECOND per-building-type registry; RETIRED 2026-08-23 when SIM1-BLDGCB made those 30 callbacks a derived seed set read from sim_bldg_type_callback_table.json, so the one function that surfaced under it -- llm_strat_bldg_anim_state_helipad -- is now attributed DISPATCH by reachability instead of by an authored owner. Do not reintroduce the category: a new callback in that registry belongs in the extraction, not in an override.) 'review' alone = not yet understood.
